questions.question: You are driving on a freeway displaying a Minimum Speed (R101) command sign showing 50. Heavy rain suddenly reduces visibility and road traction significantly. Traffic in front of you slows down to 40 km/h due to the hazardous weather conditions. What is your correct legal action?

options.text: You must maintain a speed of at least 50 km/h at all times while on this stretch of road, regardless of weather conditions, because a command sign carries mandatory authority.
You are legally permitted to drive below 50 km/h when weather, traffic, or road conditions make driving at or above the minimum speed unsafe or impossible.
You must activate your hazard lights and continue driving at 50 km/h while overtaking the slower traffic in the left-hand lane.

questions.question: You are driving a light motor vehicle (Gross Vehicle Mass under 3,500 kg) on a multi-lane road and encounter a Vehicles Exceeding Mass Only (10t) command sign pointing above or adjacent to the lane you are currently in. Which statement correctly states your legal duty?

options.text: You must immediately vacate that lane or road section, as it is designated strictly for goods/heavy vehicles whose Gross Vehicle Mass (GVM) exceeds 10 tonnes.
You may continue driving in that lane as long as you do not impede heavier 10t trucks that are trying to overtake you.
You are required to maintain a minimum speed of 80 km/h in that lane to keep up with heavy vehicle freight traffic.

questions.question: You are driving down a road and notice a blue circular command sign displaying a white arrow pointing diagonally downward to the left mounted on a physical traffic island in the center of the road. What is the legal requirement regarding how you navigate past this island?

options.text: You are legally permitted to pass to either the left or the right side of the traffic island, provided you give right-of-way to any vehicles already on your right.
You must pass to the left side of the traffic island or obstruction only; passing on the right side is a direct violation of command rules.
You are only required to pass on the left if you intend to make a left turn at the next intersection; straight-through traffic may pass on the right.

questions.question: You are driving in the left-hand lane of an approach to an intersection marked with a blue circular command sign displaying a 90-degree white arrow pointing left. There are no other road signs or lane arrows present. What is your legal duty as you enter the intersection?

options.text: You may proceed straight through the intersection if the traffic light is green and you are not obstructing vehicles behind you.
You must bring your vehicle to a complete stop, indicate left, and yield to all cross-traffic before completing the turn.
You are legally mandated to turn left at the intersection; traveling straight ahead or turning right from that lane is strictly prohibited.

questions.question: You are approaching an intersection and encounter a blue circular command sign displaying a curved arrow pointing to the left. What is your strict legal duty when navigating this intersection?

options.text: You are legally required to turn left immediately at or before the sign/intersection; proceeding straight through or turning right is strictly prohibited.
You must turn left only if there is traffic approaching from behind you; otherwise, you may proceed straight through if the lane is clear.
You may turn left or proceed straight ahead, but you are prohibited from making a U-turn or turning right into opposing lanes.

questions.question: You are driving down a street and come across a blue circular command sign showing the symbol of a pedestrian. What does this sign legally mandate regarding vehicle access and road usage?

options.text: You may drive through the area at a reduced speed of no more than 20 km/h, provided you yield to pedestrians on marked zebra crossings.
The designated road, lane, or footway is reserved strictly for pedestrians, and all motor vehicles, motorcycles, and pedal cyclists are legally prohibited from entering.
Only delivery motor vehicles are permitted to enter during daylight hours, but all other motor vehicles must detour.

questions.question: You are driving a motor car and notice a blue circular command sign showing a white bicycle symbol posted at the entrance of a dedicated lane. Which statement accurately describes the legal rule for this lane?

options.text: The designated lane or carriageway is reserved exclusively for pedal cycles; all motor vehicles, motorcycles, and pedestrians are strictly prohibited from using it.
Motor vehicles may drive in the lane during peak traffic hours, provided they yield right-of-way to any cyclists present.
Motorcycles under 125cc may use the lane, but larger vehicles and motor cars must stay in the main traffic lane.

questions.question: You are driving a motor vehicle near a recreational park and spot a blue circular command sign displaying symbols of both a pedal cycle and a pedestrian side-by-side. What is the legal requirement for this designated pathway?

options.text: Motorcyclists under 125cc may share the path with cyclists and pedestrians, but motor cars are prohibited.
Motor vehicles may enter the pathway at speeds below 15 km/h to park, provided they yield to both cyclists and pedestrians.
The pathway or lane is strictly reserved for the exclusive use of pedal cyclists and pedestrians; all motor vehicles are legally prohibited.

questions.question: You notice a blue circular command sign with a vertical line dividing a pedestrian symbol and a pedal cycle symbol. What does the vertical dividing line on this sign legally dictate?

options.text: Pedestrians and cyclists may mix freely across the whole width of the path, provided cyclists ride under 15 km/h.
The path is segregated; pedestrians must use only the designated side of the pathway shown on their side of the dividing line, and cyclists must stay on their specified side.
Motor vehicles and motorcycles may use the pedestrian side of the divided path during off-peak hours.

questions.question: You are driving a motor car along a multi-lane roadway and notice a blue circular command sign displaying a white motorcycle symbol mounted above the far-left lane. Which statement correctly outlines the legal restriction for this lane?

options.text: Only light motor vehicles (under 3,500 kg GVM) and motorcycles are allowed to use this lane; heavy goods vehicles are banned.
Motorcyclists are permitted to use this lane exclusively during peak traffic hours, but motor cars may use it to overtake.
The lane or roadway is strictly reserved for the exclusive use of motorcycles; all motor cars, trucks, and non-motorized road users are legally prohibited from using it.
